snippet.title: Gembound Gameplay Trailer: Roguelite Match-3 RPG
snippet.description:
Gembound - a match-3 roguelite built around deckbuilding mechanics. Available on Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.solonenko.gembound

In most match-3 games (like Puzzle Quest), new gems drop from an infinite random pool. In Gembound, the board is dealt from a finite 121-gem satchel that you build and edit during your run.

How the satchel system works:

• Same as deck of cards (Draw → Board → Discard → Reshuffle): Combat starts by shuffling your satchel into a draw pile. Matched gems go to the discard pile and reshuffle back in when the draw pile is empty.

• Deckbuilding & thinning: Between fights you can swap gems, remove weak colors to thin your satchel, upgrade gem quality and enhance gems with effects like healing, burning, etc.

• Spells scale with satchel composition: Spells get stronger based on how many gems of that color are in your satchel. Adding red gems makes red more common on the board and makes your red-based spells hit harder.

• Shared board: Both you and the enemy play on the same board dealt from your satchel. But only you get the benefits of upgraded gems and enchantments (enemies match at base value).

The game includes:

• 3 classes: Warrior, Mage, and Rogue
• 4 regions with elites and bosses
• 4 animal companions with active abilities
• Optional Rift Encounters with weird modifiers for both sides
• Roguelite meta: Gold, XP, companion bonds, and a persistent Gem Chest
• Full controller / handheld support
• Full paid game, no IAPs, no ads
